text:
olivia: quick Q for the pool creation form UX — inline errors or a top error summary on submit? i built a short prototype of both.
diego: inline for this use case. the form is small (6ish fields) and people usually fix one field at a time.
frank: agree, inline is nicer. implementation note: we can keep current validators and auto-focus first invalid field.
anya: small caveat: when there are multiple errors (min>max, missing billing tag, invalid name) users still want a single place to see "all of them". propose inline + a tiny persistent banner after submit: "3 problems — view details".
olivia: that banner could be an in-page compact list that also jumps to fields. keyboard focusable anchors would help a11y.
access-bot: accessibility reminder: ensure an aria-live region announces the number of errors and focus is moved to first invalid control. provide clear aria-labels on inputs.
diego: required field marker question — asterisk only vs explicit "Required" label. compliance asked for explicit label in some places.
anya: balanced approach: asterisk on desktop to avoid visual clutter, but show a small "Required" helper under the label on mobile (where asterisks are easy to miss). reserve vertical space to avoid layout shifts.
frank: dev note: reserve a fixed 16px area beneath labels so showing/hiding "Required" doesn't push content.
olivia: destructive action copy on pool detail: current modal just asks to type "delete pool". we should be more explicit: "Delete pool and all cached artifacts — irreversible" and require full pool name + a checkbox "I understand charges may persist".
access-bot: for destructive flows, use role=alertdialog, ensure focus trap, keyboard dismiss, and the confirmation input has an aria-describedby linking to the consequences text.
anya: CTA language: primary should read "Delete pool" (critical) not just "Delete". add a tiny "Export logs" link in the modal footer to reduce accidental loss.
olivia: decision: inline field errors by default + persistent banner after submit with a compact, focusable list that jumps to each invalid field; asterisk on desktop + explicit "Required" text on mobile; destructive modal with explicit copy, typed-confirm full name + checkbox, role=alertdialog. i'll update figma and PR the formik onSubmit changes, tagging you for copy + a11y review.
diego: sounds good — please tag me for the layout spacing changes.
frank: i'll add the small aria-live region and the focus-jump helpers in the PR.
access-bot: checklist suggestion: aria-live present, first-invalid focused, alertdialog role, inputs have aria-label/aria-describedby, keyboard tabbable anchors, color contrast for error text.
olivia: thanks — i'll post the PR and figma link shortly :thumbsup:
